# Load and Preprocess Data

There are three separate samples which were taken from Prolific between the 3rd and 27th of March, 2026. 

The first data set corresponds to the 1st EFA condition (participants only saw 1 of the vignettes), the second data set reflects the 2nd EFA condition (participants saw all 3 vignettes, randomised), and the third set of data is the sample collected for the CFA (participants saw all 3 vignettes, randomised). 

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| id: datain

# EFA sample for Condition 1 ---------------------------------------------------
fn <- ('data/Musical Meaning - Condition 1_March 3, 2026_12.25.csv')
d1 <- read_qualtrics(filename = fn, controlQ = "MM_25", condition = "between") 
df1 <- make_it_long(d1, verbose = FALSE)
df1b <- participant_reliability(df1, THRESHOLD = 0.001) 

# EFA sample for Condition 2 ---------------------------------------------------
fn <- ('data/Musical Meaning - Condition 2_March 5, 2026_10.05.csv')
d2 <- read_qualtrics(filename = fn, controlQ = c("MM1_25","MM2_25","MM3_25"), 
                     condition = "within")
df2 <- make_it_long(d2, verbose = FALSE)
df2b <- participant_reliability(df2, THRESHOLD = 0.001)

# CFA sample -------------------------------------------------------------------
fn <- ('data/Musical Meaning - CFA_March 27, 2026_10.47.csv')
d3 <- read_qualtrics(filename = fn, controlQ = c("MM1_24","MM2_24","MM3_24"), 
                     condition = "CFA")
df3 <- make_it_long(d3, verbose = FALSE)
df3b <- participant_reliability(df3, THRESHOLD = 0.001)

```

## Descriptive Statistics (EFA Con. 1, EFA Con. 2, & CFA)

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| id: descriptives

des_table <- rbind(descriptives(df1b, "EFA Con. 1"), 
                   descriptives(df2b, "EFA Con. 2"),
                   descriptives(df3b, "CFA"))

knitr::kable(des_table, caption = "Descriptives Statistics",
  align = c("l", "c", "r", "r", "r", "c", "r", "r"))

```

## Is the EFA Data Suitable for Factor Analysis?

Checking whether the data is suitable with KMO and Bartlett's test.

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| id: prepEFA

# Condition 1: all vignettes ---------------------------------------------------
Con1_all <- prepare_EFA(df1b, vignette_filter = "ALL")
  
  cm <- cor(Con1_all, method = "pearson")
  KMO(cm)
  cortest.bartlett(cm, n = nrow(Con1_all))

# Condition 2: by vignette -----------------------------------------------------
Con2_ST <- prepare_EFA(df2b, vignette_filter = 1)
Con2_SE <- prepare_EFA(df2b, vignette_filter = 2)
Con2_SO <- prepare_EFA(df2b, vignette_filter = 3)

# Aggregate
Con2_ST$vignette<-1
Con2_SE$vignette<-2
Con2_SO$vignette<-3

 stopifnot(ncol(Con2_SE) == ncol(Con2_ST),
          ncol(Con2_SO) == ncol(Con2_ST))

colnames(Con2_SE)<-colnames(Con2_ST)
colnames(Con2_SO)<-colnames(Con2_ST)

Con2_all <- rbind(Con2_ST, Con2_SE, Con2_SO) # ready for EFA analysis

# Con2_all suitability check
Con2_all_no_vig <- dplyr::select(Con2_all,-vignette)

cm <- cor(Con2_all_no_vig, method = "pearson")
  KMO(cm)
  cortest.bartlett(cm, n = nrow(Con2_all_no_vig))

```

# Comparing Conditions

## Cleaning prior to comparison of Within and Between conditions

For comparison, we need to remove the nine items which were added between the two EFA conditions.

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| id: clean

df1b$Type<-"Con. 1: Between"
df2b$Type<-"Con. 2: Within"

Data <- rbind(df1b,df2b)

# table(Data$Vignette,Data$Type) 
# works, but note that extra items for the second data set are still included

remove_these <- c("ST1_8","ST2_8","ST3_8",
                  "SE1_11","SE2_11","SE3_11",
                  "SE1_12","SE2_12","SE3_12",
                  "SE1_13","SE2_13","SE3_13",
                  "SO1_8","SO2_8","SO3_8",
                  "SO1_9","SO2_9","SO3_9",
                  "SO1_10","SO2_10","SO3_10",
                  "SO1_11","SO2_11","SO3_11",
                  "SO1_12","SO2_12","SO3_12")

df2b_filt <- dplyr::filter(df2b,!item %in% remove_these)
# table(df2b_filt$item) # cursory check

Data <- rbind(df1b, df2b_filt)
# table(Data$Vignette,Data$Type) # cursory check 

Data$item_code <- "Emotion"
Data$item_code[str_starts(Data$item,"S")]<-"Scale"
Data_items <- dplyr::filter(Data,item_code=="Scale")
#table(Data_items$Vignette,Data_items$Type) # cursory check

```

# Running the EFA

We conducted a parallel analysis for each condition separately. We removed items with low communialities (commented out) and reran the EFA analysis for both conditions.

There is a issue between set.seed and fa.parallel, where fa.parallel simulations do not abide by the set.seed call. So, we conducted a simulation of fa.parallel for each condition to see which factor model is supported by a majority of simulations. Because of this, the plotting occasionally report different results than the majority opinion (5 factors are hard coded following simulation of 1000 fa.parallel simulations).

```{r}

  Median = median(x$communality),
  Range = range(x$communality))
```

### Which EFA Models look best

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| id: fit_EFA

fit_table <- rbind(
  #extract_fa_fit(fa_solution_Con1, label = "Con1 Full"),
  extract_fa_fit(fa_solution_Con1_clean, label = "EFA: Con. 1 - Cleaned"),
  #extract_fa_fit(fa_solution_Con2,       label = "Con2 Full"),
  extract_fa_fit(fa_solution_Con2_clean, label = "EFA: Con. 2 - Cleaned"))

knitr::kable(fit_table,caption = "EFA Model Fit Measures",
             align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c", "r", "r", "r", "r"))

# The top 3 items from EFA 1 ---------------------------------------------------

# Structure:  ST_2 + ST_6 + ST_1
# Memory:     SE_2 + SE_1 + SE_3
# Identity:   SE_7 + SE_10 + SE_6
# Object:     SO_5 + SO_4 + SO_2
# Culture:    SO1_3 + SO1_7

# The top 3 items from EFA 2 ---------------------------------------------------

# Structure:  ST1_3 + ST1_6 + ST1_2
# Memory:     SE1_2 + SE1_1 + SE1_3
# Identity:   SE1_13 + SE1_10 + SE1_12
# Object:     SO1_4 + SO1_5 + SO1_2
# Culture:    SO1_3 + SO1_7 + SO1_12

# Differences between EFA best factor items-------------------------------------

# ST_1 is not cross loaded in EFA 1, might explain why ST_3 came ahead in EFA 2.
# Adding the new items for Identity refocused the factor, ST_7 & ST_6 get dropped
# SO_12 works as a third item for the Culture factor.

```

```{r}
  group_by(ID, VigNro, Construct) %>%

  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

  round(val_cors, 3),
```

# CFA Analysis

## Prepping the data for CFA analysis

Includes renaming of columns for aggregation and binding the vignettes into a single object to put forward for lavaan. Also, a check of the suitability of the data for factor analysis.

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| id: prepCFA

prep_with_id <- function(df3b, vignette_num) {
  tmp <- prepare_EFA(df3b, vignette_filter = vignette_num)
  tmp$ID       <- rownames(tmp)
  tmp$vignette <- vignette_num
  tmp
}

CFA_ST <- prep_with_id(df3b, 1)
CFA_SE <- prep_with_id(df3b, 2)
CFA_SO <- prep_with_id(df3b, 3)

 stopifnot(ncol(CFA_SE) == ncol(CFA_ST),
          ncol(CFA_SO) == ncol(CFA_ST))

colnames(CFA_SE)<-colnames(CFA_ST)
colnames(CFA_SO)<-colnames(CFA_ST)

CFA_all <- rbind(CFA_ST,CFA_SE,CFA_SO)    # ready for CFA

CFA_all_no_vig <- dplyr::select(CFA_all,-vignette, -ID)

#Checking suitability fo CFA_all
cm <- cor(CFA_all_no_vig, method = "pearson")
  print(KMO(cm))
  print(cortest.bartlett(cm, n = length(unique(CFA_all$ID))))

# What about the skew and kurtosis of the CFA data
CFA_item_stats <- psych::describe(CFA_all_no_vig, na.rm=FALSE, interp = TRUE, skew = TRUE, ranges = FALSE, quant = c(.25,.75))

knitr::kable(CFA_item_stats, digits = 3, caption = "CFA: Item Level Statistics",
  align = c("c", "c", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r"))

```

# Running a CFA

Corresponds to the third data sample collected (df3b). First, we take the best 3 items from the EFA to confirm the EFA model. Second, we evaluate which items are best from the new sample and tier our CFA analysis (e.g., all from EFA, best 4, best 3).

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| id: CFA
set.seed(3108)

# Best 3 items from EFA condition 2 taken into a CFA model
MMgEFA <- '
Structure =~ ST1_3 + ST1_6 + ST1_2
Memory =~ SE1_2 + SE1_1 + SE1_3
Identity =~ SE1_13 + SE1_10 + SE1_12
Object =~ SO1_4 + SO1_5 + SO1_2
Culture =~ SO1_3 + SO1_7 + SO1_12
'

fit_groupEFA <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMgEFA, data = CFA_all, meanstructure = TRUE, 
                            estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ID") 
print(summary(fit_groupEFA, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE))

fit.measEFA <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit_groupEFA, c("tli","chisq","df","pvalue",
                                                   "cfi","rmsea","srmr"))
print(fit.measEFA)

lavaan::lavInspect(fit_groupEFA, "cor.lv")

AVE(fit_groupEFA)

compRelSEM(fit_groupEFA, tau.eq = FALSE, ord.scale = FALSE)

# Great model!
# We know that this model is suitable and it confirms the EFA. 
# Considering the items differ, are there other models which fit the five factors?

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CFA on all of the high loading EFA items, lets see if a good model is in there.

MMg <- '
Structure =~  ST1_1 + ST1_2 + ST1_3 + ST1_4 + ST1_5 + ST1_6 + ST1_8
Memory =~     SE1_1 + SE1_2 + SE1_3 + SE1_4 + SE1_5 + SE1_6 + SE1_7 + SE1_9 + SO1_11
Identity =~   SE1_8 + SE1_10 + SE1_12 + SE1_13
Object =~     SO1_1 + SO1_2 + SO1_4 + SO1_5 + SO1_6 + SO1_8 + SO1_10
Culture =~    SO1_3 + SO1_7 + SO1_12
'

fit_group1 <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMg, data = CFA_all, meanstructure = TRUE,
                          estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ID")
print(summary(fit_group1, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE))

fit.meas_g1 <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit_group1, c("tli","chisq","df","pvalue", 
                                                 "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
print(fit.meas_g1)

# Let's take the top 4 loading items forward (3 for Culture)

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
MMg2 <- '
Structure =~  ST1_4 + ST1_6 + ST1_2 + ST1_5
Memory =~     SE1_9 + SE1_2 + SE1_1 + SE1_3
Identity =~   SE1_8 + SE1_10 + SE1_12 + SE1_13
Object =~     SO1_4 + SO1_5 + SO1_10 + SO1_2
Culture =~    SO1_3 + SO1_7 + SO1_12
'

fit_group2 <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMg2, data = CFA_all, meanstructure = TRUE,
                          estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ID")
print(summary(fit_group2, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE))

fit.meas_g2 <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit_group2, c("tli","chisq","df","pvalue", 
                                                 "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
print(fit.meas_g2)

# Now let's evaluate how well the best 3 items work as a model.

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
MMg3 <- '
Structure =~  ST1_4 + ST1_6 + ST1_2
Memory =~     SE1_9 + SE1_2 + SE1_1
Identity =~   SE1_8 + SE1_10 + SE1_13
Object =~     SO1_4 + SO1_5 + SO1_2
Culture =~    SO1_3 + SO1_7 + SO1_12
'

fit_group3 <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMg3, data = CFA_all, meanstructure = TRUE,
                          estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ID")
print(summary(fit_group3, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE))

fit.meas_g3 <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit_group3, c("tli","chisq","df","pvalue", 
                                                 "cfi", "rmsea", "srmr"))
print(fit.meas_g3)

lavaan::lavInspect(fit_group3, "cor.lv")

AVE(fit_group3)

compRelSEM(fit_group3, tau.eq = FALSE, ord.scale = FALSE)

```

# Testing Measurement Invariance and Discriminat Validity

Let's compare configural, metric, scalar, and strict invariance for the two best models

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| id: MI_discriminat
set.seed(3108)

# Model 4 - Top 3 items from CFA item loading filer process --------------------

fit_config3 <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMg3, data = CFA_all, estimator = "MLR",
                           meanstructure = TRUE, group = "vignette")

fit_metric3 <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMg3, data = CFA_all, estimator = "MLR",
                           meanstructure = TRUE, group = "vignette", 
                           group.equal = "loadings")

fit_scalar3 <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMg3, data = CFA_all, estimator = "MLR",
                           meanstructure = TRUE, group = "vignette", 
                           group.equal = c("loadings","intercepts"))

fit_strict3 <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMg3, data = CFA_all, estimator = "MLR",
                           meanstructure = TRUE, group = "vignette", 
                           group.equal = c("loadings","intercepts","residuals"))

lavaan::lavTestLRT(fit_config3, fit_metric3, fit_scalar3, fit_strict3)

# Looks like Model 4 passes metric invariance but failed scalar 

# Full fit table for the invariance sequence Model 4 ---------------------------
inv3 <- rbind(collect_fit(fit_config3, "Configural", include_ic = FALSE), 
              collect_fit(fit_metric3, "Metric", include_ic = FALSE), 
              collect_fit(fit_scalar3, "Scalar", include_ic = FALSE), 
              collect_fit(fit_strict3, "Strict", include_ic = FALSE))

knitr::kable(inv3, caption = "Model 4: Measurement Invariance Fit Indices", 
             align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c", "r"))

# Δ fit indices table Model 4 --------------------------------------------------
delta3 <- rbind(delta_fit(fit_config3, fit_metric3, "Configural", "Metric"),
                delta_fit(fit_metric3, fit_scalar3, "Metric", "Scalar"),
                delta_fit(fit_scalar3, fit_strict3, "Scalar", "Strict"))

knitr::kable(delta3,caption = "Model 4: Δ Invariance Tests", 
             align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "c", "r", "r"))

# Looking at the discriminat validity for Model 4 ------------------------------
semTools::discriminantValidity(object = fit_group3, cutoff = 0.85)
semTools::htmt(model = MMg3, data = CFA_all)
lavaan::lavInspect(fit_group3, "cor.lv")

# For both, all of the factor correlations pass the strict cutoff of 0.85
# Identity-Structure and Culture-Identity have the highest

#-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Model 1 - Top 3 items from EFA

fit_configEFA <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMgEFA, data = CFA_all, estimator = "MLR",
                             meanstructure = TRUE, group = "vignette")

fit_metricEFA <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMgEFA, data = CFA_all, estimator = "MLR",
                             meanstructure = TRUE, group = "vignette", 
                             group.equal = "loadings")

fit_scalarEFA <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMgEFA, data = CFA_all, estimator = "MLR",
                             meanstructure = TRUE, group = "vignette", 
                             group.equal = c("loadings","intercepts"))

fit_strictEFA <- lavaan::cfa(model = MMgEFA, data = CFA_all, estimator = "MLR",
                             meanstructure = TRUE, group = "vignette", 
                             group.equal = c("loadings","intercepts","residuals"))

lavaan::lavTestLRT(fit_configEFA, fit_metricEFA, fit_scalarEFA, fit_strictEFA)

# Looks like the confirmed EFA model passes all invariance

# Full fit table for the invariance sequence for EFA model ---------------------
invEFA <- rbind(collect_fit(fit_configEFA, "Configural", include_ic = FALSE), 
                collect_fit(fit_metricEFA, "Metric", include_ic = FALSE), 
                collect_fit(fit_scalarEFA, "Scalar", include_ic = FALSE), 
                collect_fit(fit_strictEFA, "Strict", include_ic = FALSE))

knitr::kable(invEFA, caption = "Model EFA: Measurement Invariance Fit Indices", 
             align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c", "r"))


# Δ fit indices table for EFA model --------------------------------------------
deltaEFA <- rbind(delta_fit(fit_configEFA, fit_metricEFA, "Configural", "Metric"),
                  delta_fit(fit_metricEFA, fit_scalarEFA, "Metric", "Scalar"),
                  delta_fit(fit_scalarEFA, fit_strictEFA, "Scalar", "Strict"))

knitr::kable(deltaEFA, caption = "Model EFA: Δ Invariance Tests", 
             align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "c", "r", "r"))

# Discriminant validity for EFA model ------------------------------------------
semTools::discriminantValidity(object = fit_groupEFA, cutoff = 0.85)
semTools::htmt(model = MMgEFA, data = CFA_all)
lavaan::lavInspect(fit_groupEFA, "cor.lv")

# All of the factor correlations pass the strict cutoff of 0.85
# Identity-Structure and Culture-Identity are again highest correlations
# Not as strong as in the Model 4 but Identity still has correlations across all factors

```

# Testing dimensiality of constructs (unidimensional, bifactor, hierarchical)

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| id: bifactor

# Check whether a general factor underlies five-factor solution ----------------
uni <- '
uni =~ SE1_13 + SE1_10 + SE1_12 + ST1_3 + ST1_6 + ST1_2 + SE1_2 + SE1_1 + SE1_3 + SO1_4 + SO1_5 + SO1_2 + SO1_3 + SO1_7 + SO1_12
'

fit_uni <- lavaan::cfa(model = uni, data = CFA_all, meanstructure = TRUE, 
                            estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ID")
#summary(fit_uni, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
fit.measuni <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit_uni, c("tli","chisq","df","pvalue",
                                                   "cfi","rmsea","srmr","mfi"))
fit.measuni

# a general factor alone is poor compared to the Model 1 fit

# Testing a bifactor model -----------------------------------------------------
# for bifactorIndices, the model architecture needs to be redone.
bifac <- '
general =~ ST1_3 + ST1_6 + ST1_2 + SE1_2 + SE1_1 + SE1_3 + SE1_13 + SE1_10 + SE1_12 + SO1_4 + SO1_5 + SO1_2 + SO1_3 + SO1_7 + SO1_12

Structure =~ ST1_3 + ST1_6 + ST1_2
Memory =~ SE1_2 + SE1_1 + SE1_3
Identity =~ SE1_13 + SE1_10 + SE1_12
Object =~ SO1_4 + SO1_5 + SO1_2
Culture =~ SO1_3 + SO1_7 + SO1_12

SE1_12 ~~ 0.005*SE1_12
'
#constrained heywood case
fit_bifac <- lavaan::cfa(model = bifac, data = CFA_all, meanstructure = TRUE,
                         estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ID", orthogonal = 
                           TRUE, std.lv = TRUE)
#summary(fit_bifac, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
fit.measbi <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit_bifac, c("tli","chisq","df","pvalue",
                                                "cfi","rmsea","srmr","mfi"))
fit.measbi

# ωH: hierarchical omega
compRelSEM(fit_bifac, tau.eq = FALSE, ord.scale = FALSE, true = "omega.H")

# ωT: sub scale omega for each factor
compRelSEM(fit_bifac, tau.eq = FALSE, ord.scale = FALSE)

# ω for subscales are all strong (.814-.907), factors seem stable independent of a general factor.
# Identity may be functioning as the general factor given it's correlations

bifactorIndices(fit_bifac, UniLambda = fit_uni)

# ECV (explained common variance) & PUC (Percent Uncontaminated Correlations) from a bifactor model. The bifactorIndices requires a slightly different configuration than compRelSEM but generally the same model.

# ECV below .6 indicates that the general factor may not be a strong justification
# hierarchical Omega > .8 would suggest general factor is dominant regardless of ECV
# PUC is similar to hierarchical ω, > .8 may still support unidimensionality
# H Index > .7 indicates well-defined by indicators

# bi-factor is likely not supported, ECV is below .60 (.49) and hierarchical ω is borderline > .8 (.79). Although, PUC is supported > .8 (.86), and H index for 2 factors (Identity, Structure & Culture) fall below > .7 which indicates the general factor may take more 

#----------------------------------------------------------------------------

second <- '
Structure =~ ST1_3 + ST1_6 + ST1_2
Memory =~ SE1_2 + SE1_1 + SE1_3
Identity =~ SE1_13 + SE1_10 + SE1_12
Object =~ SO1_4 + SO1_5 + SO1_2
Culture =~ SO1_3 + SO1_7 + SO1_12

f1 =~ Identity + Memory 
f2 =~ Object + Culture
'

fit_second <- lavaan::cfa(model = second, data = CFA_all, meanstructure = TRUE,
                         estimator = "MLR", cluster = "ID")
summary(fit_second, standardized = TRUE, fit.measures = TRUE)
fit.measSec <- lavaan::fitMeasures(fit_second, c("tli","chisq","df","pvalue",
                                                "cfi","rmsea","srmr","mfi"))
fit.measSec

compRelSEM(fit_second, tau.eq = FALSE, ord.scale = FALSE)

```

```{r}
factor_scores <- as.data.frame(lavaan::predict(fit_groupEFA))
factor_scores$ID      <- CFA_all$ID
factor_scores$vignette <- CFA_all$vignette

factor_names <- c("Structure", "Memory", "Identity", "Object", "Culture")

score_external <- function(data, prefix, label) {
  data %>%
    dplyr::filter(str_starts(Construct, prefix)) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(ID, VigNro) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(!!label := mean(value, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")
}

EDR_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "EDR", "EDR")
FM_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "FM", "FM")
CB_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "CB", "CB")
PEP_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "PEP", "PEP")
AIA_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "AIA", "AIA")

Wond_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "Wonder", "Wonder")
Tran_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "Transcendence", "Transcendence")
Tend_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "Tenderness", "Tenderness")
Peac_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "Peacefulness", "Peacefulness")
Nost_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "Nostalgia", "Nostalgia")
JoyA_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "Joyful Activation", "Joyful Activation")
Powr_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "Power", "Power")
Sadn_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "Sadness", "Sadness")
Tens_scores <-score_external(CFA_Data, "Tension", "Tension")

external_df <- EDR_scores %>%
  dplyr::left_join(FM_scores, by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(CB_scores, by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(PEP_scores, by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(AIA_scores, by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Wond_scores,  by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Tran_scores,  by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Tend_scores,  by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Peac_scores,  by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Nost_scores,  by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(JoyA_scores,  by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Powr_scores,  by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Sadn_scores,  by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::left_join(Tens_scores,  by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  dplyr::rename(vignette = VigNro) 

validity_df <- factor_scores %>%
  dplyr::left_join(external_df, by = c("ID", "vignette"))

external_names <- c("EDR","FM","CB","PEP","AIA","Wonder","Transcendence","Tenderness","Peacefulness","Nostalgia","Joyful Activation","Power","Sadness","Tension")

# Running a correlation --------------------------------------------------------
cor_matrix <- cor(
  validity_df[, c(factor_names, external_names)],
  use = "pairwise.complete.obs"
)

validity_cors <- cor_matrix[factor_names, external_names]

knitr::kable(round(validity_cors, 3),
             caption = "Convergent Validity: CFA Factor Scores vs. External Measures")

# Correlation test -------------------------------------------------------------
cor_tests <- psych::corr.test(
  validity_df[, factor_names],
  validity_df[, external_names],
  use   = "pairwise",
  adjust = "fdr"
)
print(cor_tests, short = FALSE)
```

```{r}
  facet_wrap(~ Source, labeller = labeller(Source = c(EFA = "EFA (Con. 2)"))) +

# MecScale differences across vignettes ----------------------------------------

prop_max <- function(x, max_val) x / max_val

mec_lmer_data <- all_long %>%
  filter(Scale == "MecScale", Source == "EFA") %>%
  mutate(
    item_key   = str_replace(item, "^MecScale\\d+_", "MecScale_"),
    Mechanism  = mec_item_map[item_key],
    VigNro     = factor(as.character(VigNro), levels = c("1","2","3")),
    prop_score = prop_max(value, 5)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Mechanism))

# lmer on item-level data; (1|Mechanism) accounts for scale differences
mec_lmer <- lmer(prop_score ~ VigNro + (1|ID) + (1|Mechanism),
                 data = mec_lmer_data)
print(summary(mec_lmer))

# MecScale: pairwise contrasts
mec_emm   <- emmeans(mec_lmer, ~ VigNro)
mec_pairs <- pairs(mec_emm, adjust = "fdr")
print(mec_pairs)

# Sub-scale proportions per vignette
mec_prop_sub <- mec_lmer_data %>%
  group_by(VigNro, Mechanism) %>%
  summarise(pct    = round(mean(prop_score, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
            .groups = "drop")
#print(mec_prop_sub)

knitr::kable(mec_prop_sub,
             caption = "MecScale Mechanism Proportions by Vignette (EFA Sample)",
             digits  = 2,
             align   = c("l","l","l"))

            SE = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),

# Participant-level valence/arousal (CFA only)
haas_circ_cfa <- haas_data %>%
  filter(Source == "CFA") %>%

  ) %>%

  summarise(

################################################################################
# ---------------------------------- MMI ---------------------------------------
################################################################################

factor_vignette_means <- bind_rows(lapply(names(factor_items), function(fname) {
  items <- factor_items[[fname]]
  CFA_all %>%
    select(ID, vignette, all_of(items)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = all_of(items),
                 names_to  = "item",
                 values_to = "score") %>%
    group_by(ID, vignette) %>%
    summarise(person_mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(vignette) %>%
    summarise(M  = mean(person_mean, na.rm = TRUE),
              SD = sd(person_mean,   na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(Factor = fname)
})) %>%
  rename(VigNro = vignette) %>%
  mutate(VigNro = factor(as.character(VigNro), levels = c("1","2","3")),
         Factor = factor(Factor, levels = factor_names)) %>%
  arrange(VigNro, desc(M))

knitr::kable(factor_vignette_means, digits = 3,
             caption = "Mean MMI Scores by CFA Factor and Vignette (1–5 scale)")

factor_dominant <- factor_scores %>%
  rename(VigNro = vignette) %>%
  mutate(VigNro = as.character(VigNro)) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(factor_names),
               names_to  = "Factor",
               values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(ID, VigNro) %>%
  slice_max(score, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(ID, VigNro, Top_Factor = Factor)

factor_dominant %>%
  mutate(VigNro = factor(VigNro, levels = c("1","2","3"))) %>%
  count(VigNro, Top_Factor) %>%
  group_by(VigNro) %>%
  mutate(
    Total = sum(n),
    Pct   = round(100 * n / Total, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(VigNro, desc(Pct)) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Dominant Factor per Vignette (% of participants)")

# Join MMI onto participant circumplex coordinates ---------------------------------
haas_circ_factor <- haas_circ_cfa %>%
  mutate(VigNro = as.character(VigNro)) %>%
  left_join(factor_dominant, by = c("ID", "VigNro")) %>%
  mutate(
    VigNro     = factor(VigNro,     levels = c("1","2","3")),
    Top_Factor = factor(Top_Factor, levels = factor_names)
  )

             labeller = labeller(VigNro = c("1" = "Vignette 1 (Structure)",
                                            "2" = "Vignette 2 (Self)",
                                            "3" = "Vignette 3 (Source)"))) +
  scale_colour_manual(values   = factor_colours,
                      labels   = factor_names,
                      name     = "Dominant Factor",
                      na.value = "grey70") +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("1" = 17, "2" = 16, "3" = 15),
                     guide  = "none") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 2), ylim = c(-0.75, 0.70)) +
  labs(
    x = "Valence  (Negative to Positive)",
    y = "Arousal  (Low to High)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    legend.direction = "horizontal"
  ) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3, alpha = 1),
                               ncol = 5))

print(p_circumplex_factor)

```

# Other Circumplex plots

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| id: circumplex

top2_label <- function(df, group_col, name_col, pct_col) {
  df %>%
    group_by({{ group_col }}) %>%
    slice_max({{ pct_col }}, n = 3, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
    summarise(
      label = paste0({{ name_col }}, " (", {{ pct_col }}, "%)",
                     collapse = "\n"),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}

# MecScale top-2 (EFA only) ----------------------------------------------------
mec_top2 <- top2_label(mec_prop_sub, VigNro, Mechanism, pct) %>%
  rename(mec_label = label)

# GEMS top-2 (CFA only) --------------------------------------------------------
gems_top2 <- top2_label(gems_prop_sub, VigNro, Emotion, pct) %>%
  rename(gems_label = label)

# MEEM top-2 (split by source) -------------------------------------------------
meem_prop_sub_efa <- all_long %>%
  filter(Scale == "MEEM", Source == "EFA") %>%
  mutate(
    item_key   = str_replace(item, "^MEEM\\d+_", "MEEM_"),
    Subscale   = meem_sub_map[item_key],
    VigNro     = factor(as.character(VigNro), levels = c("1","2","3")),
    prop_score = prop_max(value, 5)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Subscale)) %>%
  group_by(VigNro, Subscale) %>%
  summarise(pct = round(mean(prop_score, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
            .groups = "drop")

meem_prop_sub_cfa <- meem_prop_sub

meem_top2_efa <- top2_label(meem_prop_sub_efa, VigNro, Subscale, pct) %>%
  rename(meem_label = label)

meem_top2_cfa <- top2_label(meem_prop_sub_cfa, VigNro, Subscale, pct) %>%
  rename(meem_label = label)

# MMI factor proportions (% of max per factor) ---------------------------------

mmi_prop_cfa <- factor_scores %>%
  rename(VigNro = vignette) %>%
  mutate(VigNro = factor(as.character(VigNro), levels = c("1","2","3"))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = all_of(factor_names),
               names_to  = "Factor",
               values_to = "score") %>%
  group_by(VigNro, Factor) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(VigNro) %>%
  mutate(
    shifted = mean_score - min(mean_score) + 0.001,
    pct     = round(shifted / sum(shifted) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(VigNro, Factor, pct)

mmi_top2_cfa <- top2_label(mmi_prop_cfa, VigNro, Factor, pct) %>%
  rename(mmi_label = label)

# EFA centroid -----------------------------------------------------------------
haas_circ_efa <- haas_data %>%
  filter(Source == "EFA") %>%
  mutate(
    valence_sign = ifelse(str_detect(Quadrant, "Positive"),  1, -1),
    arousal_sign = ifelse(str_detect(Quadrant, "High"),       1, -1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(ID, VigNro) %>%
  summarise(
    Valence = mean(value * valence_sign, na.rm = TRUE),
    Arousal = mean(value * arousal_sign, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(VigNro = factor(as.character(VigNro), levels = c("1","2","3")))

haas_circ_means_efa <- haas_circ_efa %>%
  group_by(VigNro) %>%
  summarise(mV = mean(Valence), mA = mean(Arousal), .groups = "drop")

# EFA: MecScale + MEEM (EFA) + MMI (EFA) ---------------------------------------
top_annot_efa <- mec_top2 %>%
  left_join(meem_top2_efa, by = "VigNro") %>%
  left_join(haas_circ_means_efa, by = "VigNro") %>%
  mutate(
    Source   = "EFA",
    VigNro   = factor(as.character(VigNro), levels = c("1","2","3")),
    ann      = paste0(
      "── MecScale ──\n", mec_label,  "\n",
      "── MEEM ──\n",     meem_label
    ),
    nudge_x  = c( -0.5, -1.9, -1.50),
    nudge_y  = c( 1.3,  1.2, -0.85),
    box_xmin = mV + nudge_x - 0.60,
    box_xmax = mV + nudge_x + 0.60,
    box_ymin = mA + nudge_y - 0.68,
    box_ymax = mA + nudge_y + 0.68
  )

# CFA: GEMS + MEEM (CFA) + MMI (CFA) -------------------------------------------
top_annot_cfa <- gems_top2 %>%
  left_join(meem_top2_cfa, by = "VigNro") %>%
  left_join(haas_circ_means_cfa, by = "VigNro") %>%
  mutate(
    Source   = "CFA",
    VigNro   = factor(as.character(VigNro), levels = c("1","2","3")),
    ann      = paste0(
      "── GEMS ──\n",  gems_label, "\n",
      "── MEEM ──\n",  meem_label
    ),
      nudge_x  = c( -0.5, -1.8, -1.90),
    nudge_y  = c( 1.4,  1.3, -0.8),
    box_xmin = mV + nudge_x - 0.60,
    box_xmax = mV + nudge_x + 0.60,
    box_ymin = mA + nudge_y - 0.68,
    box_ymax = mA + nudge_y + 0.68
  )

top_annot_both <- bind_rows(top_annot_efa, top_annot_cfa)

# plotting with annotation boxes -----------------------------------------------
p_circumplex <- ggplot(haas_circumplex,
                       aes(x = Valence, y = Arousal,
                           colour = VigNro, fill = VigNro)) +
  stat_ellipse(alpha = 0.12, geom = "polygon", level = 0.70) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.20, size = 1.0) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed",
             linewidth = 0.4, colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(data = top_annot_both,
             aes(x = mV, y = mA),
             shape = 18, size = 5, colour = "black",
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_point(data = top_annot_both,
             aes(x = mV, y = mA, colour = VigNro),
             shape = 18, size = 4,
             inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = top_annot_both,
               aes(x = mV, y = mA,
                   xend = mV + nudge_x * 0.82,
                   yend = mA + nudge_y * 0.82,
                   colour = VigNro),
               linewidth = 0.35, linetype = "dotted",
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_rect(data = top_annot_both,
            aes(xmin = box_xmin, xmax = box_xmax,
                ymin = box_ymin, ymax = box_ymax),
            fill = "white", colour = "grey70",
            linewidth = 0.3, alpha = 0.90,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_text(data = top_annot_both,
            aes(x = mV + nudge_x,
                y = mA + nudge_y,
                label = ann,
                colour = VigNro),
            size = 2.2, lineheight = 1.20,

  theme(
    legend.position  = "bottom",
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#e8e8e8"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    aspect.ratio     = 1
  )

print(p_circumplex)
```
